_comment: Read by scripts/make_mesh.py, scripts/unit_patches.py and scripts/make_case.py. The values are the solved runs'. Metres, kelvin, kg/s, watts, degrees, seconds.
_boxes: x0 y0 z0 x1 y1 z1; the unit and the bed are each written as one closed STL by make_mesh.py

ports._ports: faces of snappyHexMesh's unitWall patch moved into intake and outlet by unit_patches.py, by face centre; the outlet is the front strip and the underside strip as one patch; the areas are checked to 1%

_massFlow: kg/s through the half unit: 343 CFM, the MSZ-GS12NA's top cooling airflow (wet coil), at 32 C, halved
_Q: W into the half room, negative: the rated 12,000 BTU/h at a sensible heat factor of 0.77 (2.71 kW sensible), halved
_vane: the jet's angle below horizontal: held at the top, 10 degrees, throughout; swing a triangle wave top-bottom-top, 12 s each way, starting at the top at t = 0. The solved runs' 1 s tests used a 0.5 s cycle

layers._layers: storedLayerWall80 on unitSideWall, farWall, sideWall and ceiling (12.7 mm gypsum) and on the floor (19 mm wood), 24 layers each, starting at T0, adiabatic backs; written into 0/T as given
